correctness.rationale: The fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph and its 336 automorphisms are verified by independent collineation counts. Connected four-sets count 98, each with an integral private boundary triangle; the dual full two-skeleton yields 188 free second homology generators and, via duality, only degree-nine cut homology. The exact signed Lefschetz formula gives all 336 traces. The direct 15,815-face calculation and independent 14/91/364/98 Alexander-dual calculation agree for every automorphism; exact group averages are zero. See embedded verify.py and actual output.

value.rationale: The complete rational automorphism character of a canonical girth-six graph is a natural finer invariant than its 188-dimensional homology. It gives qualitative information invisible from Betti counts: every point–line duality has zero trace; neither collineations nor the whole group have fixed homology classes, and the topologically nontrivial complex has rationally acyclic symmetry quotient. This precise symmetry classification is self-contained and does not rely on unsupported claims of downstream impact.
